question: Select the most appropriate option for blank (5)
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**into**" implies transformation or change from one state to another. (में बदलना)
 
• In the context of the passage, "convert food into energy" indicates the process of changing food into a form the body can use as energy.
 
• The other options: "**on**," "**in**," and "**onto**" do not convey the idea of transformation appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The B vitamins found in whole grains also help your body convert food into__ energy.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **On (पर)**: generally indicates a position above and in contact with a surface.
 
• **In (में)**: indicates inclusion within space, a place, or limits.
 
• **Onto (पर)**: indicates movement towards a surface.
